Definition: Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliezer = "God is help"; 1) Abraham's Damascene servant; 2) a son of Moses; 3) a Benjamite; 4) a priest who helped move the ark; 5) a Reubenite; 6) a prophet who spoke to Jehoshaphat; 7) a Levite chief; 8) son of Harim; 9) priest with foreign wife
